purpose_ar: سيناريوهات ثابتة لفحص المسار الكامل وتجهيز عرض الديمو النهائي.
purpose_en: Deterministic scenarios for full-flow QA and the final demo presentation.

scenarios.starting_message: بدي وظيفة Python Backend Developer مناسبة لمهاراتي
scenarios.objective_ar: عرض رحلة المستخدم من طلب الوظيفة حتى نتيجة الجاهزية ورابط الفرصة.
scenarios.objective_en: Demonstrate the journey from a job request to readiness and the opportunity link.

operator_steps.expected: A relevant or closely related job is displayed.
Match score, matched skills, and missing required skills are visible.
At most two roadmaps for missing required skills are displayed.
The assessment result passes and explanations appear only after submission.
A deterministic readiness score, status, strengths, gaps, action, and disclaimer are displayed.
The configured demo job URL opens only after the click.

expected_ui: Job result appears inside the existing chat flow
Learning roadmap appears without a new page
Assessment appears without exposing answers before submission
Final readiness card appears in the same flow
must_not_happen: No duplicate Streamlit widget key error
No automatic opening of the job URL

scenarios.starting_message: اعرضلي وظيفة Backend Developer بتطلب Docker
scenarios.objective_ar: إثبات أن الدرجة المرتفعة لا تعطي جاهز للتقديم عند فشل اختبار مهارة مطلوبة.
scenarios.objective_en: Verify that a high score cannot produce Ready to Apply after failing a required-skill assessment.

operator_steps.expected: A backend-related job containing a required skill gap is displayed.
The tested required skill receives Needs Practice.
The final status is capped and cannot be ready_to_apply.

must_not_happen: No passing result for one correct answer out of three

scenarios.starting_message: Show me a Python developer job that matches my skills
scenarios.objective_ar: التأكد أن نفس المسار يعمل بالإنجليزية واتجاه LTR.
scenarios.objective_en: Verify that the same job flow works in English with LTR presentation.

operator_steps.expected: English job results and match details are displayed.
English roadmap labels and instructions are displayed.
English questions, results, and explanations are displayed.
English readiness labels, next action, and disclaimer are displayed.

expected_ui: No Arabic label replaces an available English label
The score calculation matches the Arabic flow rules
must_not_happen: No different scoring formula based on language

scenarios.objective_ar: التأكد أن الطلب غير المحدد ينتج سؤال توضيحي قصير ولا يستدعي Model.
scenarios.objective_en: Verify that an unclear request produces a focused clarification without a model call.

operator_steps.expected: A short clarification asks for target role, experience level, or specific problem.

expected_ui: No empty job or readiness card appears

data_integrity: Protected JSON files remain byte-for-byte unchanged during QA
All referenced question answers and readiness-rule references are valid
performance: Known knowledge-base answers are returned in under one second on the target machine
Job matching does not perform network requests
No model is initialized during application startup or chat
streamlit: Assessment result survives normal Streamlit reruns in the current session
Changing the selected job clears or isolates stale job-specific assessment results
regression: Remember me remains disabled by default

presentation_notes.closing_message_ar: TAP لا يعرض الوظيفة فقط؛ بل يوضح مدى مناسبتها، يكشف الفجوة، يقترح طريقاً عملياً، ويتحقق من الجاهزية قبل التقديم.
presentation_notes.closing_message_en: TAP does more than list a job: it explains the fit, identifies the gap, recommends a practical path, and checks readiness before applying.
